summary: Frontend-only validation of Tax AI Assistant. Verified header + two tabs, Web search (returns real web results with titles+URLs), AI Search (returns ~2k char answer with 3 numbered citation sources), suggestion chip trigger, Tax Database seeded view (25 putusan, 9 peraturan), PDF upload (/api/putusan/upload) with metadata extraction producing a new putusan title (PUT-004812.14/2021/PP/M.IIIA Tahun 2023), file download of uploaded PDF via download-original-button, and Files modal listing 16 stored files. All critical flows pass end-to-end against the live preview URL.

integration_issues.issue: The shared `query` state is not cleared when switching from Tax Knowledge to Tax Database. If a user searched e.g. 'PMK 81 tahun 2024' on Knowledge and then clicks the Tax Database tab, Database loads with that stale query and shows 'Belum ada putusan/peraturan yang cocok' (0 results) even though 25 putusan + 9 peraturan are seeded. Clearing the search box or refreshing fixes it. goToDatabase() should reset query/filters.

issues: Native <select> for 'Semua jenis sengketa' overlaps the putusan list items on open; while opened, clicking the top putusan rows is intercepted. Minor UX nuisance (not blocking because closing the select resolves it).

action_items: In App.js goToDatabase(), reset `query` (and optionally `filters`/`perFilter`) so navigating from Knowledge to Database starts fresh instead of inheriting the previous web-search query.
Consider replacing native <select>s on the Database page with shadcn Select so dropdowns don't overlap putusan rows.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 625 lines in a single component — exceeds the 700-line soft cap for the file but the component itself is massive. Recommend splitting Home into KnowledgeView, DatabaseView, PutusanView, and modal subcomponents for maintainability.

Shared `query` state is reused across Knowledge web search, Database search, and in-document search strip. This causes cross-view contamination (see integration issue). Each view should have its own search state or goToX() should reset.
Several API calls (loadDocument, compareDocuments, sendQuestion, loadPeraturan, togglePeraturanStatus) have no error UI/toast — failures are swallowed silently, making diagnosis harder for end-users.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded /app/test_putusan_header.pdf via UI as a new putusan during testing (persisted; now visible in Files modal).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 requested frontend flows pass against preview URL. Only a minor UX issue remains: shared `query` state causes Database tab to appear empty after a Knowledge search. Backend-wise everything the frontend hits (/api/search, /api/ai-search, /api/putusan, /api/peraturan, /api/putusan/upload, /api/files, /api/files/{id}/download) returned healthy responses. Web search ~10-12s, AI search ~15-25s in practice.
